title: Taken aboard a spacecraft from his Moscow apartment

tellings.quote: calling me. I approached the window and there was something like a translucent pipe glowing made of some matter.

plain: In 1997, in his top-floor apartment in Moscow, a man named Kiran Ilum Xenov, presented on the show as the president of a Russian republic, says he felt something calling him, went to the window, and saw "something like a translucent pipe glowing," made of some kind of matter, before being taken aboard a spacecraft. Xenov tells this as his own experience, and if true it would be a first-hand account of being taken by beings from a craft.
